name: Vân Đài Terrace (Vân Đài Thạch Đỉnh)
elevation: ~2,800 meters altitude above sea of clouds

arena_geometry.surface_material: Weathered dark granite flagstones with shallowly etched concentric Daoist Bagua geomantic rings, faint micro-fissures and desaturated dried moss
arena_geometry.perimeter: Low ancient stone balustrade (0.7m height) with weathered cloud-pattern relief, chipped and eroded by centuries of exposure
arena_geometry.boundary_dropoff: Sheer vertical cliff walls descending into perpetual mountain cloud sea

north.features: Precipice opening onto boundless undulating sea of white-grey clouds; jagged vertical peak silhouettes piercing through fog layer under cold morning sky

south.features: Solid mountain shoulder ledge; strictly designated zone for 100% of camera setups to maintain immutable 180-degree action axis

west.features: Weathered ancient stone archway monolith (3.5m height); starting combat position for White Cultivator facing East

east.role: Stage Right / Black Initial Sector / Sunrise Vector
east.features: Ancient weathered dragon-cloud pillar (4.0m height); starting combat position for Black Cultivator facing West; horizon source of eventual morning sunlight

center.features: Paver center with concentric circular runic etchings, faint surface scuffs and hairline cracks from previous martial clashes

spatial_continuity_rules.camera_axis_restriction: Camera must remain strictly in South hemisphere (azimuth 150° to 210°). Zero camera crossings to North side.
spatial_continuity_rules.screen_direction_phase1_x01_x07: White Cultivator occupies screen-left (West) facing East; Black Cultivator occupies screen-right (East) facing West.
spatial_continuity_rules.spatial_inversion_x08: Shot X08 Aerial Inversion: White Cultivator executes aerial leap arcing cleanly from West to East across Black Cultivator; landing on East ledge facing West; Black Cultivator pivots in center facing East.
spatial_continuity_rules.screen_direction_phase2_x09_x12: White Cultivator occupies screen-right (East) facing West; Black Cultivator occupies screen-left (West/Center) facing East.

phase_1_x01_x06.lighting_character: Cold diffuse grey-cyan dawn cloudlight, soft wrap-around ambient, subtle blue shadows
phase_1_x01_x06.mist_density: Dense low-drifting mountain fog skimming 20cm above flagstones

phase_2_x07_x09.lighting_character: Turbulent mist backlit by rising horizon glow; sharp glancing edge light on wet stone and spinning blade edges; bursting amber sparks upon blade-barrier impact
phase_2_x07_x09.mist_density: Dispersed and swirling radially from kinetic shockwaves

phase_3_x10_x12.lighting_character: Ruptured cloud ceiling; directional warm morning sunlight (5200K) piercing through mist from East-Southeast, illuminating White Cultivator in luminous gold rim-light while Black Cultivator kneels in calm desaturated shadow
phase_3_x10_x12.mist_density: Thinning luminous mist evaporating into golden haze
